resources.string: Live subtitles and chat translation on top of the CHZZK app (or any app playing a stream).

1. Paste your free Groq key below.
2. Tap Start and allow the permissions (display over other apps, screen recording).
3. Open a stream in the CHZZK app.
4. Tap the floating CC button → "Chat area" and drag the boxes over the chat.
Turn on subtitles or chat translation first
Chat is read from the screen area you choose (CC button → Chat area). The picture is read on this phone and never uploaded — only the recognised chat text is sent for translation.
Free keys, no card needed. They stay on this phone and are only sent to Groq / NVIDIA.
NVIDIA API key (optional — better with slang)
Member names, fan names, greetings and memes — the English or Japanese version is picked from \"Translate into\". Your own terms below are used first.
Names & terms (one per line, e.g. 멤버이름 = Member Name)
All day (~15 s behind, ~8 h a day)
Fast (5–10 s behind, 3–5 h a day)

How it works: Android asks to allow screen recording when you start. The app uses it to hear the stream\'s sound and, if chat translation is on, to read the chat area you picked. Nothing is recorded or saved, and pictures never leave the phone. Sound from other apps can be captured too, so stop it when you\'re done (CC button → Stop, or the notification).
Blue: where the chat is. Green: where its translation goes.\nDrag a box to move it, drag a corner to resize.
Subtitles need the audio capture (microphone) permission
Allow \"Display over other apps\" for this app, then come back
Paste your free Groq API key first
Groq API key is invalid — check it in the app
Groq\'s free speech limit is used up — subtitles resume at %1$s
Speech limit reached — resuming in %1$d s
Translation limit reached — showing Korean for a moment
Chat translation limit reached — catching up shortly
Couldn\'t read the screen — chat translation is off this time
